title: 手机碎屏去维修，怎么说？
summary: 屏幕碎了去维修店：描述问题、先问价格、问保修，全程英语这样说。

featuredPhrase.en: My screen is cracked. How much to fix it?
featuredPhrase.zh: 我屏幕碎了，修一下多少钱？

phrases.en: My screen is cracked. How much to fix it?
phrases.zh: 我屏幕碎了，修一下多少钱？

phrases.en: How long will the repair take?
Is there a warranty on the repair?
I need a new charger for my iPhone.
phrases.zh: 我的 iPhone 需要一个新的充电器。

phrases.en: Can you back up my data first?
phrases.zh: 能先帮我备份一下数据吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, my screen is cracked. How much to fix it?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我屏幕碎了，修一下多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: What model is it? For an iPhone 13, it's $129.
dialogue.zh: 什么型号？iPhone 13 的话 129 美元。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Okay. How long will the repair take?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: About an hour. Is there a warranty? Yes, 90 days.
dialogue.zh: 大概一小时。有保修吗？有，90 天。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Good. Can you back up my data first?
dialogue.zh: 那就好，能先帮我备份一下数据吗？

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: Sure, we'll take care of it.
